protocol.selection: First eight fall and first eight ADL sequences, camera 0, chosen before inference.
protocol.scope: Exploratory convenience subset. Staged laboratory falls. Not a held-out subject evaluation or field accuracy claim.
protocol.citation: Kwolek B, Kepski M. Human fall detection on embedded platform using depth maps and wireless accelerometer. Computer Methods and Programs in Biomedicine 117(3), 489-501 (2014).
protocol.view: Right half of official side-by-side preview; RGB only, no depth input.
protocol.sampling: One actual decoded frame every three frames at 30 fps (10 Hz); no interpolation.
protocol.labels: Official sequence-level fall / ADL labels; no fabricated event onset annotations.
protocol.policy: Report all selected clips, including calibration failure and occlusion; freeze detector source before inference.
protocol.comparator: Single-frame 2D torso tilt >=55 degrees with visible shoulders and hips; a deliberately simple reference, not a deployed detector.
